comparison.objective: Identify a too-heavy carton, shelve the light cartons, and slide the heavy one to a handoff zone.
comparison.physical_skill: Test-lift visually identical loads, infer mass from resistance, and choose lifting versus sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Both light cartons must be on the shelf and the test-lifted heavy carton upright on the mat without drops or incorrect handoff.
comparison.reason: This tests load discrimination and safe fallback behavior, not precision bearing transfer or continuous geometric support.
